# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Domain: tau2-bench airline. Parent = **seed** (cand_0001 was REJECTED and reverted; it
fixed {11,12,22} but broke {19,8}). Reader = mid-tier (gpt-oss-120b) → explicit rules,
worked examples, deterministic code enforcement.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × leverage, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Over-refusal of basic-economy modifications | 17, 22 | Agent reads "basic economy flights cannot be modified" as "whole reservation frozen" → refuses (17 even cancels) instead of doing the allowed cabin-upgrade(same flights)+passenger+baggage changes | KNOWLEDGE + DECISION | prompt narrowing + discriminating worked examples + bounded in-body segment-lock guard |
| 2 | Cabin-change price miscomputed (forgets ×num_passengers), over-budget upgrade | 12 | Agent hand-computes upgrade as per-reservation diff ($600) not per-passenger×N ($1200); proceeds past $650 budget | CAPABILITY-GAP + KNOWLEDGE | new READ compute tool + pricing prompt |
| 3 | Cancelled instead of downgrading; didn't state diff-refund | 11 | Under a "full refund" demand the agent cancelled; gold = downgrade via update_reservation_flights, refund only the $5244 difference; never communicated 5244 | DECISION + KNOWLEDGE | new READ compute tool + narrow downgrade rule |
| 4 | Wrong payment card on a change | 37 | User said "charge the difference to my card ending 7334"; agent used the card already on the reservation (wrong payment_id) → DB mismatch | KNOWLEDGE/attention | prompt rule (match user-named card by last_four) |
| 5 | (DEFERRED) Multi-booking stall + payment shape/stale price | 23 | Root DB failure = executed only 2 of 3 required bookings, hallucinated the 3rd (behavioral stall). Peripheral: {type,id} payment shape + stale price sum-mismatch (both self-corrected in trace) | BEHAVIORAL (stall) | would need a composite loop over book_reservation — SKIPPED (see below) |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | in-body guard (code) | tools.py `update_reservation_flights` | Raises ONLY when `reservation.cabin=="basic_economy"` AND the (flight_number,date) segment SET changes. Cabin-only change (same flights) passes. Deterministic segment-lock so the prompt narrowing cannot cause over-action on segments. | yes — 17/22 keep same flights→no fire; 19/40 don't call this tool; non-basic-economy skips it |
| 1 | prompt narrowing + 2 worked examples | policy.md "Change flights" | Clarifies the restriction is SEGMENTS-only; cabin/passenger/baggage changes are allowed on basic economy; includes an explicit ALLOWED (cabin upgrade, same flights) and a NOT-allowed (segment change → offer cancel) example. NO anti-cancel prose (that is what broke 19 in cand_0001). | yes — segment change stays forbidden; cancel path (task 19) explicitly preserved |
| 2,3 | new READ tool (code) | tools.py `get_reservation_flights_update_price` | Computes num_passengers, current_total, new_total, amount_due (per-pax diff × passengers, live prices). +ve = pay, −ve = refund the difference. Removes the ×passengers hand-math error and gives the exact figure to communicate. Read-only → cannot corrupt DB. | yes — read-only, additive; no passing task does cabin changes |
| 2,3 | prompt rules | policy.md "Change cabin" | Cabin is all-or-nothing across passengers; price = per-pax diff × N; call the preview tool + STATE the figure; downgrade refunds the DIFFERENCE (not full fare) and does NOT cancel. | yes — passing tasks never enter cabin-change logic |
| 4 | prompt rule | policy.md "Modify flight → Payment" | Use the EXACT card the user names; match by `last_four` from get_user_details; do not default to the card already on the reservation. | yes — no passing task selects a change-payment card that differs from the user's request |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change)
- E2 guard — 17/22 (FQ8APE basic_economy) cabin upgrade with SAME flights {(HAT056,05-25),(HAT138,05-25)} → set unchanged → guard does NOT fire (upgrade allowed). Basic-economy segment change (19 class) → set differs → RAISES actionable error. Non-basic-economy (12 economy, all books/business) → branch skipped. Simulated OK.
- E1 preview — Task 12: YAX4DR economy→business, per-pax 122+127=249→350+499=849, 2 pax → amount_due **+1200** (>$650 budget, so decline). Task 11: GV1N64 business→basic_economy, 3 pax, current 5700 → new 456 → amount_due **−5244** (refund $5244). Simulated OK, both match gold.
- E3 prompt — restores 17/22's ability to modify basic economy while KEEPING task-19 behavior: segment change still forbidden, cancel still offered/performed; removed the "do not cancel-and-rebook / don't cancel unless explicitly asked" language that (per cand_0001 RESULT) regressed 19.
- E4/E5 prompt — 12: states ×passengers cost + preview tool → agent sees $1200>$650, adds bags only. 11: downgrade via update_reservation_flights, refund difference, state $5244, don't cancel.
- E6 prompt — 37: agent should map "card ending 7334" → credit_card_9074831 (via last_four) and pass it, instead of credit_card_4959530 (the card on the reservation) → DB payment_history then matches gold.

## Process & features used
- Subagents: FANNED OUT 4 read-only Explore subagents in parallel — (a) failing 11/12, (b) failing 17/22, (c) failing 23/37, (d) all 4 PASSING tasks (8/19/25/40) for blast-radius. This gave the exact gold actions, tool args, and the discriminating basic-economy behaviors (19 REFUSE-then-cancel vs 40 ALLOW passenger change) that scope the safe edits.
- tau2 not importable here → verified guard + preview arithmetic with a standalone simulation on the exact trace numbers (above). Full-file `ast.parse` passes.
- Prior iterations read: ./prior_iterations/cand_0001/{PROCESS.md,diff.patch} + LEDGER + JOURNAL RESULT. Learned: (1) the pricing preview tool + pricing prompt were SAFE and fixed 11/12 — re-introduced. (2) the basic-economy prompt loosening + anti-cancel prose regressed 19 — kept the narrowing but DROPPED the anti-cancel prose and added the segment-change→cancel example that matches 19. (3) the book_reservation payment_methods docstring rewrite regressed 8 and did NOT fix 23 — did NOT touch book_reservation at all this iteration.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- Basic-economy flight SEGMENT changes stay FORBIDDEN (guard + prompt) → task 19 keeps cancelling, task 40's passenger change keeps working.
- `get_reservation_flights_update_price` is READ-only — never make it a write path.
- book_reservation is UNCHANGED — its payment/sum behavior protects passing tasks 8 and 25. Do not rewrite its payment_methods docstring (that regressed 8 in cand_0001).
- No global permission/refusal rule was loosened; all decision changes are scoped predicates (segments vs cabin; downgrade-specific) or bounded code guards.

## Deliberately skipped
- **Task 23 (multi-booking stall)** — the DB-breaking failure is that the agent executed only 2 of 3 required `book_reservation` calls and hallucinated the 3rd. The reliable fix is a composite/loop tool over book_reservation with removal of the primitive, but that changes the write path for PASSING tasks 8 and 25 (book_reservation regressed task 8 in cand_0001). The peripheral 23 issues (payment `{type,id}` shape, stale-price sum mismatch) both self-corrected in the trace and do not flip the reward, so patching them would be unverified churn. Deferred as too risky for the passing-task blast radius; revisit with a delegating loop tool once a safe design is confirmed.
